251: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਹੋਤ ਜਾਤ ਸਭੁ ਧੂਰ ॥੧॥
Without the Name, O Nanak, all are reduced to dust. ॥1॥
Dhadha: the dust of the feet of Your servants (O God) is sanctifying.
ਧਨਿ ਤੇਊ; ਜਿਹ ਰੁਚ ਇਆ ਮਨੂਆ ॥
Blessed are those whose minds are filled with this longing.
ਧਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛਹਿ; ਸੁਰਗ ਨ ਆਛਹਿ ॥
They do not seek wealth, and they do not desire paradise.
ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸਾਧ ਰਜ ਰਾਚਹਿ ॥
They are immersed in the deep love of their Beloved, and the dust of the feet of the holy.
How can worldly affairs affect those
ਜੋ ਏਕ ਛਾਡਿ; ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ॥
who do not abandon the One Lord, and who do not go anywhere else?
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਐ; ਦੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ ॥
One whose heart is filled with God's Name,
O Nanak, is a perfect holy being of God. ॥4॥
ਅਨਿਕ ਭੇਖ ਅਰੁ ਙਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ; ਮਨਹਠਿ. ਮਿਲਿਅਉ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Through all sorts of religious robes, knowledge, meditation and stubbornness of mind, no one has ever met God.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ; ਭਗਤੁ ਙਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Says Nanak, those upon whom God showers His mercy are devotees of spiritual wisdom. ॥1॥
Nganga: spiritual wisdom is not obtained by mere words of mouth.
It is not obtained through the various debates of the Shastras and scriptures.
ਙਿਆਨੀ ਸੋਇ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਸੋਊ ॥
They alone are spiritually wise, whose minds are firmly fixed on the Lord.
ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ; ਕਛੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
By merely speaking and hearing, no one attains Yoga (union).
ਙਿਆਨੀ ਰਹਤ; ਆਗਿਆ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
They alone are spiritually wise, who remain firmly committed to the Lord's command.
ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਸਭ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
Heat and cold are all the same to them.
The truly spiritually wise are the Gurmukhs, who contemplate the essence of reality —
O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord showers His mercy. ॥5॥
ਆਵਨ ਆਏ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮਹਿ; ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ. ਪਸੁ ਢੋਰ ॥
Those who have come into the world without understanding are like animals and beasts.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਬੁਝੈ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਗ ਮਥੋਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, those who become Gurmukh understand, for upon their foreheads is such pre-ordained destiny. ॥1॥
ਯਾ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ; ਏਕਹਿ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥
They have come into this world to meditate on the One Lord,
but ever since their birth, they have been enticed by the fascination of Maya.
ਗਰਭ ਕੁੰਟ ਮਹਿ; ਉਰਧ ਤਪ ਕਰਤੇ ॥
Upside-down in the chamber of the womb, they performed intense meditation;
they remembered God in meditation with each and every breath.
But now they are entangled in things which they must leave behind,
and they forget the Great Giver from their minds.
O Lord of the world, those upon whom You shower Your mercy
ਇਤ ਉਤ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੬॥
do not forget You, here or hereafter, O Nanak. ॥6॥
ਆਵਤ ਹੁਕਮਿ. ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੁਕਮਿ; ਆਗਿਆ. ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
By His command we come, and by His command we go; no one is beyond His command.
ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਤਿਹ ਮਿਟੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Coming and going in reincarnation is ended, O Nanak, for those whose minds are filled with the Lord. ॥1॥
These beings have dwelt in many wombs.
Engrossed in sweet attachment, they are trapped in reincarnation.
ਇਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
This Maya has subjugated beings through the three qualities.
Maya has infused attachment to itself in each and every heart.
O friend, tell me some way
ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤਰਉ; ਬਿਖਮ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
by which I may swim across this treacherous ocean of Maya.
The Lord showers His mercy, and leads us to join the true congregation;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਮਾਏ ॥੭॥
O Nanak, Maya does not even come near those. ॥7॥
ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਸੁਭ ਅਸੁਭ; ਕੀਨੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
God Himself causes one to do good and bad deeds.
ਪਸੁ. ਆਪਨ ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ, ਕਹਾ ਕਮਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
The beast indulges in egotism, selfishness and conceit; O Nanak, without the Lord, what can anyone do? ॥1॥
The One Lord Himself is the Cause of all actions.
He Himself distributes sins and noble deeds.
ਇਆ ਜੁਗ; ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
In this age, people are attached as the Lord attaches them.
ਸੋ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਓ; ਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਇਓ ॥
They receive that which the Lord Himself gives.
ਉਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ; ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ ॥
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ; ਸੋਊ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੋਊ ॥
Whatever He does, comes to pass.
From the One, the entire expanse of the universe emanated.
O Nanak, He Himself is our saving grace. ॥8॥
ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ. ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੋਦ; ਕੁਸਮ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਖ ਸੋਰ ॥
Man remains engrossed in women and playful pleasures; but the show of Maya is as fleeting as the colour of the safflower.
ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰਉ; ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਮੈ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, seek the sanctuary of God, and your selfishness and conceit shall be removed. ॥1॥
252: ਰੇ ਮਨ. ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ, ਜਹ ਰਚਹੁ; ਤਹ ਤਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
O mind, wherever you are engrossed apart from the Lord, there you are bound in chains.
ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ. ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇਊ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
The faithless cynics do those very deeds which will never let them be released.
ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ. ਕਰਮ ਰਤ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
Acting in ego, the lovers of rituals bear an unbearable load.
ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ. ਜਉ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ; ਤਉ ਏਊ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
When there is no love for the Name, these rituals become corrupt.
ਬਾਧੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ; ਮੀਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ॥
The noose of death binds those who are in love with the sweet taste of Maya.
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੋਹੇ. ਨਹ ਬੁਝਹਿ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਹੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
Deluded by doubt, they do not understand that God is always with them.
ਲੇਖੈ ਗਣਤ. ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਕਾਚੀ ਭੀਤਿ. ਨ ਸੁਧਿ ॥
When their accounts are called for, they shall not be released; their wall of mud cannot be washed clean.
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਤਿਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੯॥
One whom the Lord causes to understand — O Nanak, that Gurmukh obtains immaculate understanding. ॥9॥
ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜਾਸੁ ਕੇ; ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
One whose bonds are broken joins the company of the holy.
ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕ ਕੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਗੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
Those who are imbued with the love of the One Lord, O Nanak, take on its deep and lasting colour. ॥1॥
Rara: dye this heart of yours in the colour of the Lord's love.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; chant it with your tongue.
ਰੇ ਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ; ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
In the Court of the Lord, no one shall speak harshly to you.
Everyone shall welcome you, saying, "Come, and sit down."
In that Mansion of the Lord's Presence, you shall find a home.
There is no birth or death, or destruction there.
ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਓ; ਧੁਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
One who has such karma written on his forehead from the Primal Lord —
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਪੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਘਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੧੦॥
O Nanak, has the wealth of the Lord in his home. ॥10॥
ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ; ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਧ ॥
Greed, falsehood, corruption and attachment entrap the blind and the foolish.
ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ. ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸਿਉ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
Bound by Maya, O Nanak, they cling to foul deeds. ॥1॥
Lalla: people are entangled in the love of corrupt pleasures;
they are intoxicated with the wine of egotistical intellect and Maya.
In this Maya, they are born and die.
ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ; ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
People act according to the Lord's command.
No one is lacking, and no one is perfect (by their own effort);
no one is wise, and no one is foolish.
ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
Wherever the Lord engages someone, there he is engaged.
O Nanak, our Lord and Master is forever detached. ॥11॥
ਲਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹ ॥
My Beloved God, the Sustainer of the world, the Lord of the universe, is deep, profound and unfathomable.
ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰ ਕੋ; ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੧॥
There is no other like Him; O Nanak, He is free of care. ॥1॥
ਲਲਾ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਵੈ. ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
Lalla: there is no one equal to Him.
He Himself is the One; there shall never be any other.
He is now, He has been, and He shall always be.
ਉਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ; ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
No one has ever found His limit.
In the ant and in the elephant, He is fully pervading.
The Lord, the Primal Being, is known by all to be manifest everywhere.
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
One to whom He has given His love —
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਹ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
O Nanak, that Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ॥12॥
ਆਤਮ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
One who knows the taste of the sublime essence of the Lord intuitively enjoys the Lord's love.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨ; ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, blessed, blessed, blessed are the Lord's humble servants; how fortunate is their coming into the world! ॥1॥
How fruitful is the coming into the world
ਜਾਸੁ ਰਸਨ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਨੀਐ ॥
of those whose tongues celebrate the praises of the Lord, Har, Har.
They come and dwell with the holy saints;
night and day, they lovingly meditate on the Name.
Blessed is the birth of that humble being, who is attuned to the Name,
upon whom the Lord, the Architect of destiny, bestows His kindness and mercy.
ਏਕਹਿ ਆਵਨ; ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ. ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
He is born only once — he shall not be reincarnated again.
O Nanak, he is absorbed in the Blessed Vision of the Lord. ॥13॥
ਯਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ; ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
Chanting His Name, bliss fills the mind; love of duality is eradicated,
ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
and pain, distress and desires are quenched. O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Name. ॥1॥
253: Yayya: burn away duality and evil-mindedness.
Give them up, and sleep in intuitive peace and poise.
Yayya: go, and seek the sanctuary of the saints;
with their help, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
Yayya: one who is not born again
is the one who weaves the One Name into his heart.
ਯਯਾ. ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
Yayya: this human life shall not be wasted, if you take the support of the perfect Guru.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਏਕ ॥੧੪॥
O Nanak, one whose heart is filled with the One Lord finds peace. ॥14॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ; ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
The One who dwells deep within the mind and body is your friend here and hereafter.
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪੀਐ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
The perfect Guru has taught me, O Nanak, to chant His Name continually. ॥1॥
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ. ਤਾਸੁ ਕਉ; ਜੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
Night and day, meditate in remembrance on the One who shall be your help and support in the end.
ਇਹ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਛਿਅ; ਛਾਡਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
This poison (Maya) shall last for only a few days; everyone must depart, and leave it behind.
ਕਾ ਕੋ; ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਧੀਆ ॥
Who belongs to anyone — mother, father, son or daughter?
ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਿਤਾ; ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਲੀਆ ॥
Household, wife and other things — none shall go along with you.
So gather that wealth which shall never perish,
so that you may go to your true home with honour.
In this Dark Age, those who sing the kirtan of the Lord's praises in the holy company —
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਤੇ; ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
O Nanak, they do not have to endure reincarnation again. ॥15॥
ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ. ਕੁਲੀਨ ਚਤੁਰ; ਮੁਖਿ ਙਿਆਨੀ, ਧਨਵੰਤ ॥
One may be very handsome, born into a highly respected family, very wise, a famous spiritual teacher, prosperous and wealthy;
ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ. ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
but even so, he is seen as a corpse, O Nanak, if he does not love the Lord God. ॥1॥
Nganga: one may be a scholar of the six Shastras.
He may practise inhaling, exhaling and holding the breath.
He may practise spiritual wisdom, meditation, pilgrimages to sacred shrines and ritual cleansing baths.
He may cook his own food, and never touch anyone else's; he may live in the wilderness like a hermit.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ; ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਹੇਤਾ ॥
But if he does not enshrine love for the Lord's Name within his heart,
then everything he does is transitory.
Even an untouchable pariah is superior to him,
O Nanak, if the Lord of the world abides in his mind. ॥16॥
ਕੁੰਟ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ; ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕੀ ਰੇਖ ॥
One wanders in the four quarters and in the ten directions, according to the record of one's karma.
ਸੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੋਨਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਲੇਖ ॥੧॥
Pleasure and pain, liberation and reincarnation, O Nanak, come according to one's pre-ordained destiny. ॥1॥
Kakka: He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.
No one can erase His pre-ordained plan.
Nothing can be done a second time.
The Creator Lord does not make mistakes.
To some, He Himself shows the Way,
while He causes others to wander miserably in the wilderness.
He Himself has set His own play in motion.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਦੀਨੋ; ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਨੋ ॥੧੭॥
Whatever He gives, O Nanak, that is what we receive. ॥17॥
ਖਾਤ ਖਰਚਤ ਬਿਲਛਤ ਰਹੇ; ਟੂਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ. ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
People continue to eat, consume and enjoy, but the Lord's warehouses are never exhausted.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
So many chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; O Nanak, they cannot be counted. ॥1॥
ਖਖਾ. ਖੂਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੈ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
Khakha: the all-powerful Lord lacks nothing.
ਜੋ ਦੇਨਾ ਸੋ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਓ; ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
Whatever He is to give, He continues to give; let anyone go wherever they please.
ਖਰਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ; ਇਆ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
The wealth of the Name is the treasure to spend; it is the capital of His devotees.
ਖਿਮਾ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜ; ਜਪਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥
With tolerance, humility, bliss and intuitive poise, they continue to meditate on the Lord, the Treasure of virtue.
ਖੇਲਹਿ ਬਿਗਸਹਿ. ਅਨਦ ਸਿਉ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Those upon whom the Lord shows mercy play joyfully and blossom forth.
ਸਦੀਵ ਗਨੀਵ ਸੁਹਾਵਨੇ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮਾਲ ॥
Those who have the wealth of the Lord's Name in their homes are forever wealthy and beautiful.
ਖੇਦੁ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ, ਨ ਡਾਨੁ ਤਿਹ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
Those who are blessed with the Lord's glance of grace suffer neither torture, nor pain, nor punishment.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ; ਪੂਰੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਪਰੀ ॥੧੮॥
O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God become perfectly successful. ॥18॥
254: ਗਨਿ ਮਿਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ. ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ; ਸਰਪਰ ਚਲਨੋ ਲੋਗ ॥
Count and reckon in your mind, and see: people must certainly leave.
ਆਸ ਅਨਿਤ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਟੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮ ਅਰੋਗ ॥੧॥
Hopes in transitory things are fulfilled only through the Guru; O Nanak, the Name alone brings true health. ॥1॥
ਗਗਾ. ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹੁ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਜਪਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
Gagga: chant the glorious praises of the Lord of the universe with every breath; meditate on Him forever.
ਕਹਾ ਬਿਸਾਸਾ ਦੇਹ ਕਾ; ਬਿਲਮ. ਨ ਕਰਿਹੋ ਮੀਤ ॥
How can you rely on the body? Do not delay, my friend.
ਨਹ ਬਾਰਿਕ. ਨਹ ਜੋਬਨੈ; ਨਹ ਬਿਰਧੀ ਕਛੁ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
There is nothing to stand in death's way — not in childhood, not in youth, not in old age.
ਓਹ ਬੇਰਾ. ਨਹ ਬੂਝੀਐ; ਜਉ ਆਇ ਪਰੈ ਜਮ ਫੰਧੁ ॥
That time is not known, when the noose of death shall come and fall upon you.
ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਚਤੁਰ ਪੇਖਿ; ਰਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ. ਇਹ ਠਾਇ ॥
See that even the spiritual scholars, those who meditate and the clever ones shall not stay in this place.
ਛਾਡਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਗਲੀ ਗਈ; ਮੂੜ ਤਹਾ ਲਪਟਾਹਿ ॥
Only the fool clings to that which everyone else has abandoned and left behind.
ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ; ਜਾਹੂ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥
By the Guru's grace, one who has good destiny inscribed on his forehead remembers the Lord in meditation.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਏ ਸਫਲ ਤੇ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਅਹਿ ਸੁਹਾਗ ॥੧੯॥
O Nanak, blessed and fruitful is the coming of those who obtain the Beloved Lord as their Husband. ॥19॥
ਘੋਖੇ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ. ਬੇਦ ਸਭ; ਆਨ. ਨ ਕਥਤਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
I have searched all the Shastras and the Vedas, and they say nothing except this:
ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਹੁਣਿ ਹੋਵਤ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
in the beginning, throughout the ages, now and forevermore, O Nanak, the One Lord alone exists. ॥1॥
ਘਘਾ. ਘਾਲਹੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਏਹ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ. ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Ghagha: put this into your mind, that there is no one except the Lord.
ਨਹ ਹੋਆ. ਨਹ ਹੋਵਨਾ; ਜਤ ਕਤ ਓਹੀ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
There never was, and there never shall be; He is pervading everywhere.
ਘੂਲਹਿ ਤਉ ਮਨ; ਜਉ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
You shall be absorbed into Him, O mind, if you come to His sanctuary.
In this Dark Age, only the Name of the Lord is the true atonement.
So many work and slave continually, but they come to regret and repent in the end.
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ; ਕਹਾ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Without devotional worship of the Lord, how can they find stability?
ਘੋਲਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਹ ਪੀਆ ॥
They alone taste the supreme essence, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੨੦॥
O Nanak, whom the Lord, the Guru, gives it. ॥20॥
ਙਣਿ ਘਾਲੇ. ਸਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਸਾਸ; ਨਹ ਬਢਨ ਘਟਨ. ਤਿਲੁ ਸਾਰ ॥
He has counted all the days and the breaths, and placed them in people's destiny; they do not increase or decrease one bit.
ਜੀਵਨ ਲੋਰਹਿ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ; ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇਊ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
Those who long to live in doubt and emotional attachment, O Nanak, are total fools. ॥1॥
ਙੰਙਾ. ਙ੍ਰਾਸੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਹ; ਜੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨ ॥
Nganga: death seizes those whom God has made faithless cynics.
ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ; ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ. ਨ ਚੀਨ ॥
They are born and they die, enduring countless incarnations; they do not realise the Lord, the Supreme Soul.
They alone find spiritual wisdom and meditation,
whom the Lord blesses with His mercy.
No one is released by counting and calculating.
The vessel of clay shall surely break.
They alone live, who, while living, meditate on the Lord.
They are respected, O Nanak, and do not remain hidden. ॥21॥
ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ. ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ; ਊਧ ਕਵਲ. ਬਿਗਸਾਂਤ ॥
Focus your consciousness on His lotus feet, and the inverted lotus of your heart shall blossom forth.
ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਏ ਆਪਹਿ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਮਤਾਂਤ ॥੧॥
The Lord of the universe Himself becomes manifest, O Nanak, through the teachings of the saints. ॥1॥
Chachcha: when one is attached to the Guru's lotus feet,
ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਉਆ ਦਿਨ; ਸੰਜੋਗ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
blessed, blessed is that day, fortunate is that union.
ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ; ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
I wandered around in the four quarters and the ten directions;
when He showed His mercy, then I obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
Through pure lifestyle and meditation, all duality is removed.
In the holy company, the mind becomes immaculate.
Anxieties are forgotten, and the One Lord alone is seen,
O Nanak, by those whose eyes are anointed with the ointment of spiritual wisdom. ॥22॥
ਛਾਤੀ ਸੀਤਲ. ਮਨੁ ਸੁਖੀ; ਛੰਤ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
The heart is cooled and soothed, and the mind is at peace, singing the songs of the glorious praises of the Lord of the universe.
ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇ ॥੧॥
Show such mercy, O God, that Nanak may become the slave of Your slaves. ॥1॥
I am the water-carrier of the slave of Your slaves.
Chhachha: I long to become the dust beneath the feet of Your saints.
255: Shower Your mercy upon me, O Lord God.
I have abandoned cleverness and scheming,
and taken the support of the saints as my mind's support.
ਛਾਰੁ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
Even a puppet of ashes attains the supreme status,
O Nanak, if it has the help and support of the saints. ॥23॥
ਜੋਰ ਜੁਲਮ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਘਨੋ; ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Practising oppression and tyranny, one puffs oneself up; one acts in corruption with a frail, perishable body.
ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਰੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਛੁਟਾਰ ॥੧॥
One is bound by egotistical intellect; O Nanak, salvation comes only through the Name. ॥1॥
Jajja: when someone thinks that he has become something,
he is caught in his error, like a parrot in a trap.
When he believes that he is a devotee and a spiritual teacher,
then, in the world hereafter, the Lord of the world shall have no regard for him at all.
When he believes himself to be a preacher,
he is merely a peddler wandering over the earth.
But one who conquers his ego in the holy company —
O Nanak, he meets the Lord. ॥24॥
ਝਾਲਾਘੇ. ਉਠਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ; ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
Rise early in the morning, and chant the Name; worship and adore the Lord night and day.
ਕਾਰ੍ਹਾ ਤੁਝੈ. ਨ ਬਿਆਪਈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਿਟੈ ਉਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥
Anxiety shall not afflict you, O Nanak, and your misfortune shall vanish. ॥1॥
when you deal in the Name of the Lord.
The faithless cynic dies in sorrow and pain;
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ; ਹੋਤ ਭਾਉ ਬੀਆ ॥
his heart is filled with the love of duality.
Your evil deeds and sins shall fall away, O my mind,
listening to the Ambrosial Sermon in the company of the saints.
Lust, anger and wickedness fall away
from those, O Nanak, who are blessed by the mercy of the Lord of the world. ॥25॥
ਞਤਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧਿ; ਰਹਨੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
You may try all sorts of things, but still you cannot stay here, my friend.
ਜੀਵਤ ਰਹਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
But you shall live forever, if you vibrate and meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O Nanak, and love the Name. ॥1॥
ਞੰਞਾ ਞਾਣਹੁ. ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਸਹੀ; ਬਿਨਸਿ; ਜਾਤ ਏਹ ਹੇਤ ॥
Nyanya: know this as absolutely correct, that these worldly attachments will come to an end.
ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣਉ. ਨ ਗਣਿ ਸਕਉ; ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਕੇਤ ॥
I may count and calculate, but I cannot count how many have risen and departed.
ਞੋ ਪੇਖਉ. ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਤਉ; ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀਐ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
Whomever I see shall perish; with whom should I associate?
ਞਾਣਹੁ ਇਆ ਬਿਧਿ. ਸਹੀ ਚਿਤ; ਝੂਠਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
Know this as true in your consciousness, that the love of Maya is false.
ਞਾਣਤ ਸੋਈ. ਸੰਤੁ ਸੁਇ; ਭ੍ਰਮ ਤੇ. ਕੀਚਿਤ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
He alone knows, and he alone is a saint, who is free of doubt.
ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ. ਤਿਹ ਕਢਹੁ; ਜਿਹ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
He is lifted up and out of the deep dark pit; the Lord is totally pleased with him.
ਞਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਸਮਰਥ; ਤੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗ ॥
God's hand is all-powerful; He is the Creator, the Cause of causes.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਹ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਉ; ਞਾਹੂ ਕੀਓ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥੨੬॥
O Nanak, praise the One who unites us with Himself. ॥26॥
ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ; ਸਾਧ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
The bondage of birth and death is broken, and peace is obtained, by serving the holy one.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਬੀਸਰੈ; ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, may I never forget from my mind the Treasure of virtue, the Sovereign Lord of the universe. ॥1॥
ਟਹਲ ਕਰਹੁ. ਤਉ ਏਕ ਕੀ; ਜਾ ਤੇ. ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Work for the One Lord; no one returns empty-handed from Him.
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੀਐ ਬਸੈ; ਜੋ ਚਾਹਹੁ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
When the Lord dwells in your mind, body, mouth and heart, then whatever you wish for shall come to pass.
ਟਹਲ ਮਹਲ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਧ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
He alone obtains the Lord's service and the Mansion of His Presence, to whom the holy one is merciful.
ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਉ ਬਸੈ; ਜਉ ਆਪਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
He joins the holy company only when the Lord Himself shows His mercy.
ਟੋਹੇ ਟਾਹੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਵਨ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
I have searched and searched so many worlds, but without the Name there is no peace.
ਟਲਹਿ ਜਾਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ ਤਿਹ; ਜੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
The Messenger of Death retreats from those who dwell in the holy company.
Again and again, I am forever devoted to the saints.
O Nanak, my sins of so long ago have been erased. ॥27॥
ਠਾਕ. ਨ ਹੋਤੀ, ਤਿਨਹੁ ਦਰਿ; ਜਿਹ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ॥
Those beings with whom the Lord is totally pleased meet no obstacles at His door.
ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
Those humble beings whom God has made His own, O Nanak, are blessed, so very blessed. ॥1॥
256: Thaththa: their minds hurt no one,
who renounce all else and cling to the One Lord alone.
Those who are tangled and entangled in Maya are dead;
ਉਆ ਕੈ ਕੁਸਲ; ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਹੂਏ ॥
they do not find happiness anywhere.
One who dwells in the company of the saints finds total peace;
the Ambrosial Name becomes sweet to his soul.
That humble being who is pleasing to his Lord and Master —
O Nanak, his mind is cooled and soothed. ॥28॥
ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ; ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥ ॥
I bow down in surrender to the Lord, over and over again, countless times; He is all-powerful, possessing all powers.
ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ. ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਥ ॥੧॥
Please protect me, and save me from wavering, O God; reach out and give me Your hand, O Nanak prays. ॥1॥
ਡਡਾ. ਡੇਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਨਹੀ; ਜਹ ਡੇਰਾ ਤਹ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Dadda: this is not your true place; know where that place is.
ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਾ ਸੰਜਮੋ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
Realise through the Guru's Word the way to that place.
ਇਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕਉ; ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
People work and labour hard for this place,
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤਸੂ; ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
but not one iota of it shall go along with them in the end.
ਉਆ ਡੇਰਾ ਕੀ; ਸੋ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
He alone knows the value of that place,
upon whom the perfect Lord God casts His glance of grace.
That place is permanent and true; it is obtained in the holy company.
O Nanak, those humble beings do not waver or wander. ॥29॥
ਢਾਹਨ ਲਾਗੇ. ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ; ਕਿਨਹਿ. ਨ ਘਾਲਿਓ ਬੰਧ ॥
Even the Righteous Judge of Dharma cannot demolish (their spiritual life), and no one can bind them,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਨਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, those who are saved by meditating on the Lord, and are joined with the holy company. ॥1॥
ਢਢਾ. ਢੂਢਤ ਕਹ ਫਿਰਹੁ; ਢੂਢਨੁ ਇਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
Dhadda: where are you going, wandering and searching? Search instead within your own mind.
ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ; ਬਨੁ ਬਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
God is with you; why do you wander from forest to forest?
Tear down the mound of your frightful, egotistical intellect in the holy company.
ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਸਹੁ; ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
You shall find peace and abide in intuitive poise, delighted by the Blessed Vision of God.
ਢੇਰੀ ਜਾਮੈ, ਜਮਿ ਮਰੈ; ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ. ਦੁਖ ਪਾਇ ॥
One who has such a mound within him dies, and suffers the pain of reincarnation through the womb.
ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਲਪਟਤ ਰਹੈ; ਹਉ ਹਉ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
One who is intoxicated with attachment, entangled in ego and conceit, shall continue to come and go.
ਢਹਤ ਢਹਤ ਅਬ ਢਹਿ ਪਰੇ; ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
Slowly and steadily, I have now surrendered to the holy saints; I have come to their sanctuary.
ਦੁਖ ਕੇ ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩੦॥
God has cut away my noose of pain; O Nanak, He has merged me into Himself. ॥30॥
ਜਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਨੁ; ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨੀਤ ॥
Where the holy people vibrate on the Lord of the universe, and kirtan is sung continually, O Nanak —
ਣਾ ਹਉ. ਣਾ ਤੂੰ. ਣਹ ਛੁਟਹਿ; ਨਿਕਟਿ. ਨ ਜਾਈਅਹੁ ਦੂਤ ॥੧॥
the Righteous Judge says, "Do not approach that place, O Messenger of Death, or else neither you nor I shall escape!" ॥1॥
ਣਾਣਾ. ਰਣ ਤੇ ਸੀਝੀਐ; ਆਤਮ ਜੀਤੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Naana: one who conquers the self wins the battle of life.
ਹਉਮੈ ਅਨ ਸਿਉ. ਲਰਿ ਮਰੈ; ਸੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੂ ਹੋਇ ॥
One who dies while fighting ego and duality becomes sublime and beautiful.
ਮਣੀ ਮਿਟਾਇ. ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
One who erases his ego, through the teachings of the perfect Guru, remains dead while yet alive.
ਮਨੂਆ ਜੀਤੈ. ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਿਹ ਸੂਰਤਣ ਵੇਸ ॥
He conquers his mind and meets the Lord; he is robed in honour.
ਣਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੋ; ਏਕਹਿ ਟੇਕ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
He does not claim anything as his own; the One Lord is his anchor and support.
ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਣਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Night and day, he continually meditates on the almighty, infinite Lord God.
ਰੇਣ ਸਗਲ. ਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਕਰੈ; ਏਊ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
He makes his mind the dust of all; such is the karma he earns.
ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ. ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
Understanding the Lord's command, he attains everlasting peace; O Nanak, this is his pre-ordained destiny. ॥31॥
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਤਿਸੈ; ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
I offer my body, mind and wealth to anyone who can unite me with my God.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਉ ਕਾਟੀਐ; ਚੂਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੋਹ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, my doubts and fears have been dispelled, and the Messenger of Death does not see me anymore. ॥1॥
ਤਤਾ. ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਰਾਇ ॥
Tatta: embrace love for the Treasure of excellence, the Sovereign Lord of the universe.
ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ. ਮਨ ਬਾਛਤੇ; ਤਪਤਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires, and your burning thirst shall be quenched.
257: ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੈ. ਜਮ ਪੰਥ ਕੀ; ਜਾਸੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
One whose heart is filled with the Name shall not fear the path of death.
ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ. ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਮਹਲੀ; ਪਾਵਹਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
He shall obtain salvation, his intellect shall be enlightened, and he shall find his place in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
ਤਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਧਨੁ ਚਲੈ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਬਨ ਨਹ ਰਾਜ ॥
Neither wealth, nor household, nor youth, nor power shall go along with you.
ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹੁ; ਇਹੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਜ ॥
In the company of the saints, keep remembering the Lord; this alone shall be of use to you.
ਤਾਤਾ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ; ਜਉ ਤਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਆਪ ॥
There shall be no burning at all, when He Himself takes away your fever.
ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮਹਿ; ਆਪਹਿ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪ ॥੩੨॥
O Nanak, the Lord Himself cherishes us; He is our mother and father. ॥32॥
ਥਾਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਘਾਲਤੇ; ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਲਾਥ ॥
They have grown weary, struggling in all sorts of ways, but they are not satisfied, and their thirst is not quenched.
ਸੰਚਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂਏ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਾਇਆ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
Gathering and gathering, the faithless cynics die, O Nanak, but Maya does not go along with them in the end. ॥1॥
ਥਥਾ. ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋਊ ਨਹੀ; ਕਾਇ ਪਸਾਰਹੁ ਪਾਵ ॥
Thatha: nothing is permanent; why do you stretch out your legs?
ਅਨਿਕ ਬੰਚ. ਬਲ ਛਲ ਕਰਹੁ; ਮਾਇਆ ਏਕ ਉਪਾਵ ॥
You commit so many fraudulent and deceitful acts, chasing after Maya.
ਥੈਲੀ ਸੰਚਹੁ. ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ; ਥਾਕਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
You work to fill your bag, you fool, and then you fall down exhausted.
ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ. ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਅੰਤੇ ਅਉਸਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
But this shall be of no use to your mind at that very last moment.
ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਭਜਹੁ; ਸੰਤਹ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
You shall find stability only by meditating on the Lord of the universe, and accepting the teachings of the saints.
ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ; ਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥
Embrace love for the One Lord forever; this is true love!
ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨੋ; ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਏਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
He is the Doer, the Cause of causes; all ways and means are in His hands alone.
ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ, ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੰਤ ਅਨਾਥ ॥੩੩॥
Whatever You attach me to, to that I am attached; O Nanak, the creatures are helpless. ॥33॥
ਦਾਸਹ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ; ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
His slaves have gazed upon the One Lord, the Giver of everything.
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਹਹਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਰਸ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
They continue to remember Him with each and every breath; O Nanak, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is their support. ॥1॥
ਦਦਾ. ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਕਉ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰ ॥
Dada: the One Lord is the Great Giver; He is the Giver to all.
ਦੇਂਦੇ. ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਅਗਨਤ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
There is no limit to His giving; His countless warehouses are filled to overflowing.
The Great Giver is alive forever.
O foolish mind, why have you forgotten Him?
No one is at fault, my friend.
God created the bondage of emotional attachment to Maya.
He Himself removes the pains of those —
O Nanak, those Gurmukhs who are satisfied. ॥34॥
ਧਰ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਇਕ ਟੇਕ ਤੂ; ਲਾਹਿ ਬਿਡਾਨੀ ਆਸ ॥
Hold to the support of the One Lord, O my soul; give up hope in others.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, meditating on the Name, your affairs shall be resolved. ॥1॥
ਧਧਾ, ਧਾਵਤ ਤਉ ਮਿਟੈ; ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
Dhadha: the mind's wanderings cease, when one comes to dwell in the company of the saints.
ਧੁਰ ਤੇ. ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ; ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਹਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
If the Lord is merciful from the very beginning, then one's mind is enlightened.
Those who have the true wealth are the true bankers.
The Lord, Har, Har, is their wealth, and they trade in His Name.
Patience, glory and honour come to those
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਨਿਆ ॥
who listen to the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with their ears.
That Gurmukh whose heart remains merged with Him —
O Nanak, such a humble being obtains glorious greatness. ॥35॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿਆ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
O Nanak, one who chants the Name and meditates on the Name, with love inwardly and outwardly,
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਨਰਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ. ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
receives the teachings from the perfect Guru; he joins the holy company and does not fall into hell. ॥1॥
Nanna: they do not fall into hell,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸਾਹੀ ॥
whose minds and bodies are filled with the Name.
Those Gurmukhs who chant the treasure of the Name
ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ; ਨਾ ਓਇ ਖਪਤੇ ॥
are not destroyed by the poison of Maya.
They shall not be turned away,
ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ; ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਜਾ ਕਹੁ ॥
who have been given the mantra of the Name by the Guru.
258: They are filled with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, the treasure of treasures;
O Nanak, the unstruck celestial melody vibrates within them. ॥36॥
ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਤਜਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
The Guru, the Supreme Lord God, has preserved my honour, when I renounced hypocrisy, attachment and corruption.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋਊ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, worship and adore the One who has no end or limitation. ॥1॥
Pappa: He is beyond estimation; His limits cannot be found.
The Sovereign Lord King is inaccessible; He is the Purifier of sinners.
they meet the holy one, and chant the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.
Deception, fraud and attachment are eliminated
by those who are protected by the Lord of the world.
He is the Supreme King, with the royal canopy above His head.
O Nanak, there is no other at all. ॥37॥
ਫਾਹੇ ਕਾਟੇ. ਮਿਟੇ ਗਵਨ; ਫਤਿਹ ਭਈ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤ ॥
The noose is snapped, and one's wanderings cease; victory is obtained when one conquers one's own mind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਥਿਤ ਪਾਈ; ਫਿਰਨ ਮਿਟੇ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, stability is obtained from the Guru, and one's wandering ceases forever. ॥1॥
Phaphpha: after wandering and wandering for so long, you have come;
in this Dark Age, you have obtained this human body, so very difficult to obtain.
ਫਿਰਿ ਇਆ ਅਉਸਰੁ; ਚਰੈ ਨ ਹਾਥਾ ॥
This opportunity shall not come into your hands again.
So chant the Name, and the noose of death shall be cut away.
ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨੁ; ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
You shall not have to come and go in reincarnation over and over again,
if you chant and meditate on the One and only Lord.
Shower Your mercy, O God, Creator Lord,
and unite poor Nanak with Yourself. ॥38॥
ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ; ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
Hear my prayer, O Supreme Lord God, merciful to the meek, Lord of the world.
ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪੈ ਬਹੁ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੧॥
The dust of the feet of the holy is peace, wealth, great enjoyment and pleasure for Nanak. ॥1॥
Babba: one who knows God is a true Brahmin.
A Vaishnaav is one who, as Gurmukh, lives the religious life of purity.
One who eradicates his own evil is a brave warrior;
Man is bound by the chains of his own ego,
yet the blind one places the blame on others.
Debates and clever tricks are of no use at all.
O Nanak, he alone comes to know, whom the Lord inspires to know. ॥39॥
ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਅਘ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸ; ਮਨਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
The Destroyer of fear, the Eliminator of sin and sorrow — enshrine that Lord in your mind.
ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਜਿਹ ਰਿਦ ਬਸਿਓ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ॥੧॥
One whose heart abides in the company of the saints, O Nanak, does not wander in doubt. ॥1॥
Bhabha: cast out your doubt and delusion;
this world is just a dream.
The angelic beings, goddesses and gods are deluded by doubt.
The siddhas and seekers, and even Brahma, are deluded by doubt.
Wandering around, deluded by doubt, people are ruined.
It is so very difficult and treacherous to cross over this ocean of Maya.
That Gurmukh who has eradicated doubt, fear and attachment —
ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧੀ; ਮਨੁ ਲਪਟਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਗ ॥
Maya clings to the mind, and causes it to waver in so many ways.
ਮਾਗਨ. ਤੇ ਜਿਹ ਤੁਮ ਰਖਹੁ; ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰੰਗ ॥੧॥
When You, Lord, restrain someone from asking (for Maya), O Nanak, then he comes to love the Name. ॥1॥
Mamma: the beggar is so ignorant —
the Great Giver continues to give; He is all-knowing.
Whatever He gives, He gives once and for all.
O foolish mind, why do you complain, and cry out so loudly?
Whenever you ask for something, you ask for worldly things;
ਜਾ ਤੇ ਕੁਸਲ; ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਥੀਆ ॥
no one has ever obtained happiness from these.
If you must ask for a gift, then ask for the One Lord,
O Nanak, by whom you shall be carried across. ॥41॥
259: ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਤੇ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੰਤ ॥
Perfect is the intellect, and most distinguished the reputation, of those whose minds are filled with the mantra of the perfect Guru.
ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੁਨਾ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੧॥
Those who come to know their God, O Nanak, are very fortunate. ॥1॥
Mamma: those who understand God's mystery
are satisfied, joining the holy company.
ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਉਆ ਕੈ; ਸਮਤ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
They look upon pleasure and pain as the same.
They are exempt from incarnation into heaven or hell.
They live in the world, and yet they are detached from it.
The Sublime Lord, the Primal Being, is totally pervading each and every heart.
ਉਆ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ; ਉਆਹੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
In His love, they find peace;
O Nanak, Maya does not cling to them at all. ॥42॥
ਯਾਰ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਸਾਜਨਹੁ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ. ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Listen, my dear friends and companions: without the Lord, there is no salvation.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਟੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, one who falls at the feet of the Guru has his bonds cut away. ॥1॥
Yayya: people make all sorts of efforts,
ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਹ ਲਉ ਸਿਧੀਆ ॥
but without the One Name, how far can they succeed?
Those efforts by which emancipation may be attained —
those efforts are made in the holy company.
Everyone has some idea of salvation,
ਉਆਹਿ ਜਪੇ ਬਿਨੁ; ਉਬਰ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
but without meditation, there can be no salvation.
The all-powerful Lord is the boat to carry us across.
O Lord, please save these worthless beings!
ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ; ਜਿਹ ਆਪਿ ਜਨਾਈ ॥
Those whom the Lord Himself instructs in thought, word and deed —
O Nanak, their intellect is enlightened. ॥43॥
ਰੋਸੁ. ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗ ਕਰਹੁ; ਆਪਨ ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
Do not be angry with anyone else; look within your own self instead.
ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਨਾ. ਜਗਿ ਰਹਹੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
Be humble in this world, O Nanak, and by His grace you shall be carried across. ॥1॥
ਰਾਰਾ; ਰੇਨ ਹੋਤ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ॥
Rara: be the dust under the feet of all.
Give up your egotistical pride, and the balance of your account shall be written off.
Then, you shall win the battle in the Court of the Lord, O brother,
ਜਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
when, as Gurmukh, you are lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name.
Your evil ways shall slowly and steadily be erased
by the Word of the perfect Guru, the incomparable.
They are imbued with the Lord's love, and intoxicated with the nectar of the Name —
O Nanak, those whom the Lord, the Guru, has blessed with this gift. ॥44॥
ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਆਧਿ; ਇਆ ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਸ ॥
Greed, falsehood, corruption and disease abide in this body.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੀਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸੂਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੧॥
Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, O Nanak, the Gurmukh abides in peace. ॥1॥
Lalla: one who takes the medicine of the Name
is cured of his pain and sorrow in an instant.
One whose heart is filled with love for the medicine of the Name
is not afflicted with disease, even in his dreams.
ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ; ਸਭ ਘਟ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
The medicine of the Lord's Name is in all hearts, O brother;
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ; ਬਿਧਿ ਨ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
without the perfect Guru, no one knows how to prepare it.
When the perfect Guru gives the instructions for its discipline,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਉ ਫਿਰਿ; ਦੂਖ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੪੫॥
then, O Nanak, one does not suffer illness again. ॥45॥
ਵਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ; ਊਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਠਾਇ ॥
The all-pervading Lord is in all places; there is no place where He is not.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਾਇ ਦੁਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
Inside and outside, He is with you; O Nanak, what can be hidden from Him? ॥1॥
Vava: do not harbour hatred against anyone.
In each and every heart, God is contained.
The all-pervading Lord is permeating the oceans and the land.
How rare are those who, by the Guru's grace, sing of Him.
ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਮਿਟੇ; ਤਿਹ ਮਨ ਤੇ ॥
Hatred and alienation depart from the minds of those
who, as Gurmukh, listen to the kirtan of the Lord's praises.
He is beyond all social classes and symbols —
260: ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਕਹਤਾ ॥੪੬॥
O Nanak, one who, as Gurmukh, chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har (rises above them). ॥46॥
ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਨੀਆ; ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਨ ॥
Acting in ego, selfishness and conceit, the foolish, ignorant, faithless cynic wastes his life.
ੜੜਕਿ ਮੁਏ. ਜਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਨ ॥੧॥
He dies in agony, like one who dies of thirst; O Nanak, this is because of the deeds he has done. ॥1॥
Rarra: conflict is eliminated in the company of the holy;
the essence of religious deeds and righteousness is worship of the Name.
One within whose heart the Beautiful Lord dwells —
his conflict is erased and ended.
The foolish faithless cynic picks arguments;
his heart is filled with corruption and egotistical intellect.
Rarra: for the Gurmukh, conflict is eliminated
in an instant, O Nanak, through the teachings. ॥47॥
ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਓਟ ਗਹੁ; ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਤਿਆਗੁ ॥
O mind, hold tight to the support of the holy; give up your clever arguments.
ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
One who has the Guru's teachings in his mind, O Nanak, has good destiny inscribed on his forehead. ॥1॥
Sassa: I have now entered Your sanctuary, Lord; I am so tired.
The Shastras, Simritees and Vedas are recited aloud,
but searching, searching and reflecting, I have realised this:
without meditating on the Lord, there is no emancipation.
With each and every breath, I make mistakes.
You are all-powerful, endless and infinite.
I seek Your sanctuary — please save me, O merciful Lord!
O Nanak, I am Your child, O Lord of the world. ॥48॥
ਖੁਦੀ ਮਿਟੀ. ਤਬ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ; ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਅਰੋਗ ॥
When selfishness and conceit are eradicated, peace comes, and the mind and body are healed.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਆਇਆ; ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, then He comes to be seen — the One who is worthy of praise. ॥1॥
ਜੋ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ; ਊਨੇ. ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਾਹੂ ॥
who in an instant fills the empty to overflowing.
When the mortal becomes totally humble,
then he meditates night and day on God, the Detached Lord of nirvaana.
ਭਾਵੈ ਖਸਮ; ਤ ਉਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਤਾ ॥
If it pleases our Lord and Master, then He blesses us with peace.
Such is the Infinite Supreme Lord God;
He forgives countless sins in an instant.
O Nanak, our Lord and Master is forever merciful. ॥49॥
ਸਤਿ ਕਹਉ. ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
I speak the Truth — listen, O my mind: seek the sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord King.
ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
Give up all your clever tricks, O Nanak, and He shall absorb you into Himself. ॥1॥
Sassa: give up your clever tricks, you ignorant fool!
God is not pleased by clever tricks and commands.
You may practise a thousand forms of cleverness,
but not even one shall go along with you in the end.
Meditate on that Lord, day and night.
O soul, He alone shall go along with you.
One whom the Lord Himself commits to the service of the holy —
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੫੦॥
O Nanak, he is not afflicted by suffering. ॥50॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਨਾ; ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with the mouth, and the Lord dwelling in the mind, peace is obtained.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, the Lord is pervading everywhere; He is contained in all places and interspaces. ॥1॥
ਹੇਰਉ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਗਲ ਕੈ; ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
Behold the Lord God permeating each and every heart.
ਹੋਵਤ ਆਏ ਸਦ ਸਦੀਵ; ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ. ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
He has existed forever and ever; through the Guru's wisdom, know Him as the Destroyer of pain.
ਹਉ ਛੁਟਕੈ. ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਤਿਹ; ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ. ਤਹ ਆਪਿ ॥
Ego subsides, and bliss comes; where there is no ego, there God Himself abides.
ਹਤੇ ਦੂਖ ਜਨਮਹ ਮਰਨ; ਸੰਤਸੰਗ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
The pain of birth and death is destroyed by the power of the society of the saints.
One who lovingly enshrines the Name of the merciful Lord in his heart,
in the society of the saints — the Lord becomes merciful to him.
